designPrinciple: Keep lighting and kinetic electrical systems in the fixed canopy. The rotating 240-element field is mechanically driven and has no planned electrical load, avoiding a slip-ring requirement unless a later controlled design introduces rotating electrical devices.

electricalDomains.purpose: power and control of 14 fixed adjustable accent heads
electricalDomains.alternateControl: phase or supplier-specific control only when supported by the exact selected driver/PSU
electricalDomains.notes: The conceptual 4 narrow / 6 spot / 4 flood optical roles are software/commissioning group intent, not mandatory hardwired power circuits.

electricalDomains.purpose: motor/drive, motion safety chain, position/speed feedback and service controls
electricalDomains.notes: Motor, drive, braking and safety performance remain unresolved. Kinetic faults must not require disabling lighting service unless the final safety analysis explicitly requires it.

electricalDomains.purpose: commissioning, non-rotating sensors, service diagnostics and future approved auxiliary devices
electricalDomains.notes: Keep sensors non-contact/fixed where practical. Any future rotating electrical device reopens the rotary power/data transfer analysis and cannot silently assume a slip ring.

fixedCanopyContains: site power termination and protective devices as required by final market design
DALI bus power supply/application controller where used
kinetic motor drive/control and safety devices
fixedRotatingBoundary.changeControl: Any proposal for rotating powered lighting, sensors, displays or other electrical loads requires a new controlled rotary power/data transfer review.

lightingArchitecture.serviceGoal: each head removable/replaceable without destructive canopy work
lightingArchitecture.controlGoal: retain individual or finer-grained addressability where supported by selected control gear; derive groups/scenes in commissioning software rather than permanent wiring where practical

dali.addressing: commissioned after exact control gear topology is selected

blockers: exact channel/fuse/driver behavior must be supplied and tested

referenceCandidateImplementation.headInput: 24 V constant voltage according to current manufacturer page
referenceCandidateImplementation.notes: Do not promote 24 V or this PSU topology to final architecture until the exact VX4800 head family/configuration is selected and controlled.

access: serviceable canopy panels sized and located so drivers/control gear/terminals can be replaced without disturbing the 240-line setout
no routine service task may require entering the rotating sweep envelope while motion is enabled
motion lockout/mechanical restraint procedure required before service near rotating components
segregation: keep mains and power electronics separated from low-voltage/control wiring to the extent required by final product design and applicable standards
route wiring outside the rotating-carrier sweep and bearing/drive pinch zones
provide strain relief at every removable service module and head feed
do not use the bearing as an intentional protective-earth current path
identification: unique head ID linked to controlled LED setout
commissioned DALI address/group/scene record where DALI is selected
replacement: power supplies/control gear independently replaceable where architecture permits
terminal access without destructive finish removal

protectiveAndSafetyRequirements: final electrical class, protective-earthing scheme and site protective devices must be resolved for each market/released supply variant
metallic canopy/bonding design must not rely on bearings or incidental mechanical contact for protective continuity
lighting and kinetic domains require defined isolation/lockout points
kinetic emergency stop, safe torque/braking behavior and restart logic are part of the unresolved motion-safety engineering
driver/PSU thermal derating and enclosure temperature must be verified in the final canopy arrangement
all field wiring/conductors/connectors require rating for final voltage, current, temperature, installation method and market requirements
voltage-drop/current calculations require the exact selected head and driver topology
electrical access must preserve structural, bearing, cable-exit and dynamic-clearance zones
requiredEngineeringReturns: project/site nominal supply and fault/protective-device requirements
exact driver/power-supply/control-gear part numbers and channel topology
DALI-2 certification records for selected DALI products where applicable
head and driver electrical load data including inrush/standby/derating where published
wiring conductor sizes/types and voltage-drop calculation
canopy electrical thermal analysis or test evidence
service access drawing and component replacement procedure
electrical test plan for first article and production
